meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.coverage: Thirty-five financial ratios of every scheduled commercial bank: credit-deposit ratio, net interest margin, return on assets and equity, cost of funds, business and profit per employee, net NPA ratio, each year
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 1078 (data provider DP1), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. Final figures where published, else provisional. Business and profit per employee are printed in rupees to March 2015 and in ₹ lakh from March 2016 (one break, every bank); both converted to ₹ crore. 22 cells the source prints more than once with different values (2013-03-31) are left out: we cannot tell which value is right. Left out as printed in the wrong unit (Foreign banks, Westpac banking corporation, (Credit + Investment) - Deposit Ratio on 2013-03-01; Foreign banks, Westpac banking corporation, Investment - Deposit Ratio on 2013-03-01).
